audit.title: Getting Started (Chainlink Functions)

dimensions.name: Answer-first extractability
dimensions.analysis: Intro cleanly states the goal — "make requests to the Chainlink Functions Decentralized Oracle Network (DON) and make any computation or API calls offchain." But most sections open with procedural steps rather than a self-contained claim, and there is no lift-ready definition of Chainlink Functions itself.

dimensions.name: Structural scannability & chunkability
dimensions.analysis: Strong hierarchy — 12 headings, 1 H1, max depth H3, 0 level skips. One section exceeds 600 words. No tables; a summary table of the hardcoded Sepolia values (router, donID, gasLimit, LINK amount) would improve extraction.

dimensions.name: Concrete statistics & specifics
dimensions.analysis: Good hard values exist (gasLimit `300_000`, `2 LINK`, router address, donID hex, `v1.3.0`, `^0.8.20`) but the measured facts note 0 numerals carry units and "several" appears as a vague quantifier.

dimensions.name: Citations & authoritative references
dimensions.analysis: Strong — 31 links, 14 external including primary sources (github.com contract source, remix.ethereum.org), plus dense internal links to API references. No action needed.

dimensions.name: Quotable canonical definitions
dimensions.analysis: "You use a Chainlink Functions subscription to pay for, manage, and track Functions requests" is a good liftable definition. Missing an equivalent one-sentence definition of Chainlink Functions near the top.

dimensions.name: Machine-readability & metadata
dimensions.analysis: Weak. Measured: 0 JSON-LD blocks, canonical MISSING, datePublished/dateModified absent, 7 of 12 code fences untagged, no og/twitter tags. This is the largest scored deficit.

dimensions.name: Code completeness & agent-runnability
dimensions.analysis: Main contract is complete with imports, addresses, and config; JS/curl/JSON all present. Weakened by untagged snippet fences and a code inconsistency (see anti-patterns).

dimensions.name: Query/intent coverage
dimensions.analysis: Full happy-path lifecycle is covered, but no "how do I debug a failed request," no error-string sections, no FAQ. Symptom-phrased retrieval will miss.

dimensions.name: Clarity, fluency & terminology consistency
dimensions.analysis: Clean, consistent prose. Minor: `jobId` vs `donID` naming drift (see anti-patterns).

audit.summary: This is a well-structured, task-complete Chainlink Functions quickstart with a full, runnable Solidity contract, clean linking to API references, and a logical setup→deploy→run→examine flow. Its biggest GEO weakness is machine-readability: no JSON-LD/`TechArticle` schema, no canonical URL, no visible last-updated date, and 7 untagged code fences — signals engines use to trust and parse the page. The second gap is query coverage: it contains no troubleshooting/error-string sections, which is how devs and agents actually query a failing request. One critical hidden signal: the page carries a `callout="shutdown"` component whose deprecation meaning is invisible in the extractable text — an engine synthesizing this page could confidently recommend a shut-down product.

recommendations.title: Make the deprecation/shutdown status explicit in extractable text
recommendations.where: top of page, after the `<ChainlinkFunctions callout="shutdown" />` component
recommendations.issue: shutdown status lives only in a component, invisible to text extraction
recommendations.change: add a plain-text first sentence, e.g. "Note (2026): Chainlink Functions is being sunset on [networks/date]; see [migration/status link]." State the concrete status and date.
recommendations.why: engines skimming or lifting this page will otherwise recommend a shut-down product as current — the highest-severity accuracy failure.

recommendations.title: Add a troubleshooting / error-string section
recommendations.issue: no coverage of failed requests; only the happy path exists
recommendations.change: add "Why did my Functions request fail?" with liftable sub-entries for common symptoms: `UnexpectedRequestID`, request stuck at pending, "insufficient LINK balance," consumer not added to subscription, gas limit exceeded.
recommendations.why: devs and agents query by symptom, not concept; symptom-phrased headings win retrieval that tutorial prose loses.

recommendations.title: Add `TechArticle` JSON-LD, canonical URL, and visible last-updated
recommendations.issue: measured — 0 JSON-LD, canonical MISSING, no dates
recommendations.change: emit `TechArticle` schema with `headline`, `dateModified`, `programmingLanguage: [Solidity, JavaScript]`, canonical URL, and render a visible "Last updated" line.
recommendations.why: structured metadata and freshness signals raise parse-ability and E-E-A-T trust; measurably lifts citation eligibility.

recommendations.title: Add an answer-first definition of Chainlink Functions
recommendations.issue: intro jumps to "Learn how to make requests…" with no definition
recommendations.change: prepend one sentence: "Chainlink Functions is a serverless developer platform that runs custom JavaScript offchain via a Decentralized Oracle Network (DON) and returns the result onchain."
recommendations.why: a crisp, self-contained definition is the unit engines lift verbatim for "what is" queries.

recommendations.title: Add a Sepolia config summary table
recommendations.where: "Examine the code" → before the Solidity block
recommendations.issue: router, donID, gasLimit, LINK amount are scattered in comments/prose
recommendations.change: add a table: Parameter | Value | e.g. Router `0xb83E…38D0`, donID `fun-ethereum-sepolia-1`, gasLimit `300000`, subscription funding `2 LINK`.
recommendations.why: tables let engines extract exact parameters and build justified, quotable answers.

recommendations.title: Tag all code fences with language
recommendations.where: the 7 untagged snippet blocks under "Examine the code"
recommendations.why: language tags let agents parse, classify, and safely run snippets.

recommendations.title: Add "how do I…" phrasings to procedural H3s
recommendations.where: "Create a subscription", "Fund your subscription", "Add a consumer"
recommendations.change: optionally append question framings, e.g. "Create a subscription (how to fund and add a consumer)".
recommendations.why: matches natural "how do I create a Functions subscription" queries.

antiPatterns: **Code inconsistency (correctness):** the `_sendRequest` explanation snippet passes `jobId` while the actual contract uses `donID` — entity drift that confuses both readers and agents. Align to `donID`.

**Code inconsistency:** the `fulfillRequest` explanation snippet emits `Response(requestId, s_lastResponse, s_lastError)` (3 args) but the declared event has 4 params including `character`. Fix the snippet to match.
**Vague quantifier:** "available on several blockchains" — replace with a count or link-anchored specifics.
**Untagged code fences:** 7 of 12 (also captured in recommendations).
**Undated content:** no visible freshness signal on a page that is functionally deprecated.
offPageNotes: `llms.txt` is already referenced at the top — good; ensure it lists this page's canonical status.
Site-level: confirm `TechArticle` schema and canonical tags are templated across `docs.chain.link`, not just this page.
The CLI should pass raw `<head>` on the next run — head metadata could not be verified here, so schema/canonical absence is measured from served HTML only.
